runtime: Compiled ahead-of-time to native code through LLVM. ARC manages reference types and shared heap storage, while value types are not themselves universally reference-counted.

asyncRuntimes.name: Default global executor

asyncRuntimes.name: Custom SerialExecutor
asyncRuntimes.role: User-defined serial executors can control where an actor's jobs run; MainActor is a separate built-in global actor using the platform main executor.
